articles.highlight: 桑切斯称这是“对西班牙领土完整的侵犯”，欧盟多国批评马德里处理不力。
articles.summary: 约5万名移民在24小时内涌入西班牙在北非的飞地休达，导致至少57人死亡，并引发西班牙与摩洛哥的外交危机及欧盟内部争议。文章报道了这一事件的规模、政治影响以及欧盟国家对西班牙的批评，值得关注其后续对欧洲边境政策的潜在影响。

articles.sourceExcerpt: Pedro Sánchez decries ‘violation of territorial integrity’ as other EU countries criticise Madrid over incident Europe live – latest updates At least 57 people have died trying to reach the Spanish enclave of Ceuta after as many as 50,000 migrants entered the tiny territory from Morocco in what Spain’s prime minister, Pedro Sánchez, called a “a violation of Spain’s territorial integrity”. The huge influx, which took place over the course of just 24 hours, overwhelmed the city of 85,000 people, triggered a political crisis for Madrid and led to a barrage of criticism from other EU countries, including calls for Spain to be suspended from the Schengen free-movement zone.

zh.title: Show HN：Sx —— 面向 AI 技能、MCP 与命令的开源包管理器
zh.highlight: Sx 是一个开源包管理器，用于安装和管理 AI 技能、MCP 服务器与命令行工具。
zh.summary: 这篇文章介绍了 Sx，一个开源包管理器，目标是为 AI 技能、MCP（模型上下文协议）服务器和命令提供统一的安装与更新方式。它试图解决 AI 工具链中依赖和分发碎片化的问题，对构建可复用 AI 工作流的开发者有价值。
zh.failureAnalysis: 该项目的风险在于，官方 MCP 注册表和各大模型厂商自带工具市场可能挤压其生存空间；同时，让用户安装并执行第三方 AI 技能/命令存在安全与信任门槛。如果缺少杀手级生态或分发渠道，包管理器很容易因采用率不足而失败。

en.highlight: Sx is an open-source package manager for installing and managing AI skills, MCP servers, and command-line tools.
en.summary: This article introduces Sx, an open-source package manager aiming to unify the installation and update of AI skills, MCP servers, and commands. It tackles fragmentation in AI toolchains and may interest developers building reusable AI workflows.
en.failureAnalysis: The project may struggle against official MCP registries and vendor app stores, while security and trust concerns around executing third-party AI skills and commands could limit adoption. Without a killer ecosystem or distribution channel, package managers often fail from insufficient usage.
en.title: Show HN: Sx – an open-source package manager for AI skills, MCPs, and commands
